description: Define the scope of Software Project Management (SPM) Understanding a few problems related to SPM Need for careful planning, monitoring, and control

syllabus.title: Introduction to SPM
syllabus.body: Software project vs. other types of project, activities covered by SPM, categorising software projects, problems with software projects, management control, stakeholders, information and control in organizations; overview of step-wise project planning.

syllabus.title: Project Evaluation and Software Effort Estimation
syllabus.body: Strategic and technical assessment, cost-benefit analysis, cash flow forecasting, risk evaluation; problems with over/under-estimates, software effort estimation techniques, Function Point Analysis, COCOMO model.

syllabus.title: Activity Planning, Risk and Resource Management
syllabus.body: Objectives of activity planning, project schedules, sequencing & scheduling activities, network planning models; risk management: identification, analysis, evaluating risks to the schedule; resource allocation.

syllabus.title: Project Execution and Closure
syllabus.body: Project monitoring and control: project tracking, milestone analysis, activity-level analysis, defect analysis and prevention, process monitoring and audit; project closure analysis.

outcomes: Able to identify project planning objectives, along with various cost/effort estimation models.
Capable of monitoring and controlling project activities.
textbooks: Bob Hughes & Mike Cotterell, Software Project Management, McGraw-Hill Education, 3rd Edition.
Pankaj Jalote, Software Project Management In Practice, Pearson Education India; First Edition.
